items.html:
Implemented tests in tests/autodiff/test_transparent_api.py and extended the shared Engine harness.

Verified:

  • 214 transparent API tests passed across Advect, JAX JIT, PyTorch, and Autograd.
  • 84 existing Autograd physics tests passed, including physical identities and object serialization.
  • Ruff passed.

Coverage includes ordinary factories and constructors, nested materials, constant-object promotion, complex inputs, unused gradients, mixed-backend rejection, and fresh-process lazy imports. Tests exposed production issues now fixed by their owners. No commits or release contact.
